messages.subject: Integerate SVG chart with knitr?
parts:
Hi, 
  I am thinking build an application based on Shiny-server, which includes a feature of exporting PDF version report. I use Highcharts.js as the graph output. 
  My question is: is it possible to include Highcharts figures into knitr to generate pdf file? Some code like the following in ".Rnw" file:

\includesvg{path/to/chart.svg}

  currently, I use inkscape to convert svg charts to pdf figures first, then include .pdf figures into .Rnw file, hope there are some smarter solution.

Best!

Huidong

messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Integerate SVG chart with knitr?
parts:
I'm not sure if I understand your question (I do not quite see how it
is related to knitr), but I believe there are many ways to convert svg
to pdf. Inkscape might be one way, and I'm sure ImageMagick is another
way. A quick google search gives this:
http://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/2099/how-to-include-svg-diagrams-in-latex

Regards,
Yihui
